# Nothing is disallowed, and the demos are crawlable on purpose. Every page
# under /demos/ carries <meta name="robots" content="noindex">, and a crawler
# has to be able to FETCH a page to read that tag. A Disallow here would hide
# the noindex rather than reinforce it, and leave the invented institutions
# eligible for indexing on inbound links alone — a URL Google may not fetch is
# a URL it can still list. Crawlable plus noindex is what keeps them out.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# deliberately rather than by omission.
